description: Blend two or more objects (Object > Blend > Make), optionally setting the number of steps and the orientation. The objects blend in stacking order. For text designs, outlineText converts text to outlines first

orientation.description: page: steps stay upright; path: steps turn with the spine. Default page

outlineText.description: Convert text frames among the objects to outlines before blending (Type > Create Outlines), for blended lettering. The text is no longer editable. Default false

steps.description: Number of steps between the blended objects (Blend Options > Spacing: Specified Steps)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: make_blend
title: Make Blend
